study: spec 027: the previous window as a prior (not a gate)
registered: 2026-11-19, before seeds 355 and 356 exist (they are generated only in their CI runs)
classes: weak = every contact-2 window, and a contact-1 window whose hand-over is within 30 min of a contact gap or which holds at most one ownship turn; other = the rest of contact 1; each chain's first window excluded everywhere
estimand: geometric mean over windows of ctl ÷ ctl-prior, per-window median range error; 95% interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples over engagements (seed 27)

rule.gain: lower limit on the weak split above 1 (range)
rule.harm: upper limit below 1 on weak, other, contact 1 or contact 2, in range, course or speed

soundness_on_validation.S1: at least 95% of planned windows ran and no engagement missing
soundness_on_validation.S2: per-engagement geometric mean of ctl ÷ the true-history fit in [0.8, 4]
soundness_on_validation.coverage: contact-1 coverage of the carried 95% region in [0.80, 0.99]
soundness_on_validation.on_failure: the study stops before the test
